scope: durable selected SQL subset; no PostgreSQL drop-in performance conclusion; see compatibility/postgres-report.json

environment.source_tree_hash_format: SHA256 of sorted relative UTF-8 paths and source bytes, each prefixed by LE64 length; .sig/.py/.zon only, excludes caches/outputs
environment.deployment_caveat: Both engines are native processes on the same host with sibling data directories. OS synchronization is required for both; physical power-loss equivalence is not established. RAMSQL implements a SQL subset and uses conservative transaction snapshots.

workload.protocol: identical psycopg simple queries, autocommit, prepare=False, no pipeline
workload.schema_create_drop: each logical operation is one CREATE and one DROP; both request latencies are sampled
workload.insert: bounded per-client INSERT batches, retained row contents verified before DELETE reset; validation/reset phases excluded from request throughput and recorded separately
workload.timing: individual request latency includes execute and fetch/decode; active phase throughput includes Python thread orchestration; setup and warmup excluded

durability.ramsql: durable --data WAL, synchronous stable-storage hook before commit publication; no --memory
durability.limits: OS synchronization guarantees only; this experiment does not simulate hardware power loss
